name: 80s retro desklamp with MagSafe charger
description: An 80s Japanese-electronics desk lamp with a slot for a MagSafe-style wireless puck, so a phone charges face-up beside it. The body takes a standard E14 lamp socket and bulb — neither is included — and there is a small cut-out for a clock display. Print it, wire in the socket, drop in your charger. Files on Cults3D and Thangs.

faq.q: What do I need to buy separately?
faq.a: A standard E14 lamp socket and bulb, and a slim round MagSafe-style wireless charging puck. None of these are included in the files.
